step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture shows 7-Eleven's digital wallet ecosystem. On the left are client/external entry points: Mobile Device, POS, and Digital Ledger (an external ledger). In the middle/right is the AWS cloud stack: API Gateway, AWS Pinpoint, SQS, AWS Lambda, Amazon EventBridge, and MongoDB Atlas. Flow starts from Mobile Device to API Gateway to verify phone numbers via Pinpoint. POS updates the external Digital Ledger. Ledger updates are sent to SQS, which triggers Lambda to sync with MongoDB Atlas. Customer mobile transactions hit API Gateway -> Lambda -> Digital Ledger and MongoDB. Lambda also publishes events to EventBridge for downstream loyalty workflows.
